title: Eba
description: Swallow made from garri and hot water, folded until smooth and firm. Ready in minutes and perfect with egusi, efo riro or okra soup.

image.alt: Smooth ball of eba served beside a plate of green vegetable soup

ingredients.note: Yellow or white garri both work

steps.instruction: Bring the water to a rolling boil.
steps.safetyNote: Pour boiling water carefully, away from your body.

steps.instruction: Pour about three-quarters of the water into a bowl. Sprinkle the garri evenly over it and leave it to soak without stirring.

cues.visual: Garri sits on the water, then darkens as it absorbs.

image.alt: Heap of yellow garri in a basin

steps.instruction: Stir and fold firmly with a wooden spoon, pressing it against the side of the bowl until smooth. Add a splash of the remaining hot water if it's too stiff.

cues.texture: Smooth and soft but holds its shape, with no dry lumps.

steps.instruction: Shape into balls with wet hands or a wet bowl and serve straight away.

notes: Less water gives firmer eba; more gives softer. Adjust to how you like it.
Serve with egusi soup, efo riro, okra or ogbono soup.
